item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, it will permanently destroy deep-ocean ecosystems. We must protect the ocean’s depths before this damage becomes irreversible.

2. The deep ocean is not a sacrifice zone. Commercial deep-sea mining will permanently destroy its ecosystems. We are calling for protection before mining begins.

3. We will not accept permanent destruction of deep-ocean ecosystems for commercial gain. If deep-sea mining begins, those ecosystems will be lost. Protect the deep ocean now.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

The deep ocean is one of Earth’s most remarkable living places, and it must not become a sacrifice zone for commercial extraction. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, it will permanently destroy deep-ocean ecosystems. We cannot restore what is lost or undo the harm once mining starts. That is why we are standing for the protection of the ocean’s depths before commercial operations begin. The choices made now will shape the future of these ecosystems for generations to come. We are bringing people together to demand that decision-makers keep the deep ocean safe from mining and defend the living world beneath the waves.
